response.title: Monthly accounting export
response.summary: Accountants export closed months to the ERP as CSV.

useCases.title: Export a closed month
useCases.goal: Send the month's entries to the ERP
preconditions: The month is closed by the chief accountant
alternatives: The month is not closed: the export is refused

source.excerpt: export the monthly accounting entries to the ERP as a CSV file

scenarios.title: Export of a closed month
then: a CSV file with September's entries is produced

scenarios.title: Month not closed
then: the export is refused with a message saying the month is not closed

requirements.statement: Only closed months can be exported.
The CSV file is UTF-8 encoded.
